summary: Iter 91g — Verified Online - Shop Zetu is classified as warehouse across ALL warehouse-classification-dependent backend endpoints. 11/11 pytest passed against the public preview URL with the admin token.

minor.issue: Heavy endpoint occasionally returns 502 from preview ingress on cold cache (transient — passes on retry). Test wrapped in retry helper.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has is_warehouse_location() as the single source of truth (line 8832) and WAREHOUSE_KEYS now includes 'online - shop zetu' (line 8712). WAREHOUSE_NAMES (line 7192-7200) also includes the exact-case 'Online - Shop Zetu' for set-membership checks used in two places.

marketing_intel.py has a deliberate duplicate is_warehouse_location() (line 98) with a comment noting server.py is the source of truth — kept local to avoid circular import. The substring 'online - shop zetu' is correctly included (line 118). Both helpers verified to agree via unit test.

Live invariant on /api/exec-summary: stock_mix.total_stock_units == warehouse + stores. Warehouse bucket holds 31,369 units (well above the 20,000 floor) confirming Zetu's ~3,207 units are now classified there. Total ≈ 74,890 matches the expected live figure.

/api/analytics/sell-through-by-location, /api/analytics/ibt-suggestions, /api/analytics/aged-stock, /api/marketing/slow-movers, /api/analytics/replenishment-report all confirmed to EXCLUDE Online - Shop Zetu from store-side outputs.

Note: there are TWO is_warehouse_location() implementations in the codebase (server.py + marketing_intel.py). They drift independently — the unit test in this iteration is now the regression guard. Long-term consider refactoring marketing_intel.py to read WAREHOUSE_KEYS from a shared utility module to eliminate the duplication entirely.
